answer: The Physical Rekey Cap binds each agent identity to a hardware token in a vault; the token must be re-keyed by hand every 90 seconds. At zenith load the protocol freezes any identity whose token missed its window, capping one operator's hands at one identity per cycle. An attacker must rent a lantern-lit kiosk per token, so 1,000 sybils need 1,000 stations and 1,000 operator-hours per rotation.
